question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. Mukusooka, bali bakusoma kinnomu atte mukasirise, oluvanyumma, baatule, nga bagoberera obubonero obwempandika. Kika ki eky'okuyiga ekifuna mu mu bikolwa ebilagiddwa?
answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Mu bibuuzo bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira okukozesebwa okukulaakulanya endowooza y'abayizi ku ngeri gye basoma mu kibinja nga basoma wamu mu kibiina?
answer_a: Oyinza otya okuzuula amakulu g'ebigambo ebitamanyidwa?
answer_b: Ekigendererwa ekikulku mu katundu ke tumaze okusoma kye ki?
answer_c: Omutwe ki gwe wandiwadde ekwandiiko kino gwe tusoma?
answer_d: Omutwe ki  ogw'ekyo kye tumaze okusoma ?

question: Mu kiseera ky'okusoma okunnyonyola ebiwandiiko, abayizi mu kibiina ekyookuna mu pulayimale balaga ebizibu okwawula wakati w'omulamwa be ekirowoozo ekikulu. Ku binnyonyoddwa wammanga entuufu enaleetawo enjawulo?
answer_a: Omutwe gw’ekigambo gwe gulinga ennyanjula y’ekyawandiiko era gukubibwawo nga tubuuza “Kiki kye twagala okwolesa mu kyawandiiko?” ate ebiteeso ebikulu bye biringana n’amalirizo g’omutwe.
answer_b: Omulamwa gwe tuteekateeka okumaliriza ku ki ekyogerwa mu mutwe, ate ebiteeso ebikulu bye bimu ku byo ebiyamba okutuuka ku malirizo ago.
answer_c: Omutwe gw'ekigambo kye kigenda okwogerwako era kizuulwa kubanga kiba mu mutwe gw'ekitabo, ate ekirowoozo ekikulu kibeera mu katundu akasooka.
answer_d: Omutwe gw'ekigambo guddamu ekibuuzo “Ekiwandiiko kino kifa ku ki?” ate ekirowoozo ekikulu kigwa mu mugatte gw'ekyo ekigambiddwa ku mutwe ogwo.

question: Valentina ali mu kibiina kya PreK era akulakulanye mu bukugu bwe obw’okuwandiika, ng’asobola okugatta obutonnyeze okusiiga ennyiriri ez’enjawulo, n’okukuuma obutayosa mu makubo. Okusinziira ku mitendera gy’okutandika okuyiga okuwandiika, bukugu ki obuddako omuwala ono bw’asaanidde okutendeka, ng’assa ekitiibwa mu mutindo gw’obuzibu bwabyo?
answer_a: Koppa enjatuza nga bw'eziri.
answer_b: Lambulula ebibalo ebifaananyi eby'enjawulo.
answer_c: Kuba ebifaananyi bya arabesque eby'obwereere.
answer_d: Londoola amakubo nga ogoberera ettolobero n'ebiwujjo

question: Omusomesa agenda kutandika akabiina akusoma ku byakatemba. Nga tannatandika, agenda kukola akeesso akamuyamba okumanya obumanyirivu bw'abayizi, era ekigendererwa kyo'mwesso guno kwe : "Okutegeera ebintu ebikulu ebigendererwa mu bintu byaakatemba." Kiki ekikulu ekyetaagisa okuba mu mwesso guno?
answer_a: Ebyafaayo by'emizannyo egy'ekinakatemba
answer_b: Enkola ey’omunda n'eyebweru eyebintu ebinyuvu era ebinyuma
answer_c: Enjawulo enkulu wakati w'emizannyo egyisesa n'ebyo ebyenaku
answer_d: Enkola z’okunnyonnyola ebiwandiiko eby’obuwangwa

question: Soma embeera y'ekibiina wammanga: Mu zimu ku lesooni ze eziddirira, omusomesa wo olungereza Alina okumaliriza ebirina okuyigibwa: "Okukyusa ebigambo mu biwandiiko ebiwandiiko." Ku bigendererwa by'okuyiga ebiweereddwa kiriwa ekikwatagana n'ekiraga eky'okuyiga?
answer_a: Londa ebigambo ebimu ebiri mu muwandiiko
answer_b: Fumiitiriza okuva mu biwandiiko okumanya ebintu ebikulu oba ebitono ebikulu ebiwandiikiddwa.
answer_c: Laga ekirowoozo ekikulu mu mawulire agawandiike obuwandiike obugazi oba obutongole.
answer_d: Laga okutegeera amawulire agawandiike obuntuntunu oba agawandiike mu bujjuvu.

question:
Soma embeera y’omukibiina  eno wammanga:
Omusomesa w’olungereza asabye abayizi be okusoma ebiwandiiko mu bwangu ate oluvannyuma baddemu ekibuuzo bino: “Ekirowoozo ekikulu mu biwandiiko kye ki?” Mu nkola z’okusoma zino wammanga, musomesa alina nsoma ki gy’asaba abayizi be okukozesa?
answer_a: Okukenenula
answer_b: okusikambula ebyamakulu byoka
answer_c: Okusoma okwanamadala
answer_d: Okusoma okw'amaanyi

question:
Ntunuulira embeera y'ekibiina nga bweri wammanga
   Omukyala Parada,nga musomesa w'olulimi olungereza abadde akolerawamu n'abayizi be ku ngeri yo kwennyonyolako mu bigambo ebikozesebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo okumala sabiiti bbiri eziyise basobole okuba nga bennyolako nga boogers.Olwaleero omukyala awuliriza alipoota za bayizi be nga bennyonyolako engeri gye baddukanyamu emirimu gyabulijjo.Newankubadde Mukyala Parada yakizuula abayizi bangi bakoze ensobi mu nkozesa y'oluliminga boogera ,teyabateereza me bagenda mu maaso n'okwogera kwabwe.


Okusinziira ku bigenda mu maaso mu kibiina , olowooza ku bino wammanga kuendisinze okuwagira endowooza y'omusomesa.
answer_a: Akkiriza nti ensobi zibeerawo mu kuyiga.
answer_b: Akkiriziganya n'endowooza nti ensobi zibeerawo era tezewalika.
answer_c: Alina endowooza nti okubatereza kijja lkutabulatabula abayizi be.
answer_d: Alina endowooza nti abayizi bandifuddeyo ku mulama me batatunuulira nsobi.

question: Ssinga otunuulira embeera eri mu ssomero eno: Emu ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga olungereza mu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’ekimu kwe "kwogera omuntu ky’alowooza nga akozesa obwogezi obumala eddakiika nga ssatu n’emboozi ennyimpimpi nga mulimu okukyusa ebirowoozo emirundi nga kkumi na mukaaga nga mw’otadde n’emikolo gy’emyaka egiyise n’omukolo gw’okutegeeza ekyo abalala kye boogedde, ng’olaga ekigendererwa". Bwe baba bakebera obuwanguzi bw’ekigendererwa kino, abayizi mu mutendera guno basabwa kwanjula emboozi mu bubinja obw’abantu bana nga balina okukozesa ebigambo ebimu ebiweereddwa, n’enjogera era nga balina ekigendererwa ekimu. Buli bbinja lwe limaliriza okwanjula emboozi yaabwe, Mwami Fuentes, omusomesa waabwe ow’olungereza, ayimiriza emboozi okukola obulongoofu ku nsobi z’ebbalangulo oba enjatula abayizi ze bakoze. Okusinziira ku ndagiriro ezikwatagana n’okukebera eziragiddwa ku programu y’okusoma ey’omutendera guno, lwaki Mwami Fuentes aba takwatagana nazo?
answer_a: Olwokubanga enzirukanya z'ebigendererwa by'okuyiga ez'omulembe guno ziraga nti okwogera kulungi okukulaakulana mu mbeera ey'obuteefu.
answer_b: Olw’okuba okusalako omuyizi ebigambo ng’akyayogera okumukolako obubi ku ngeri gy’alimu okwogera.
answer_c: Okuva abayizi abava ebweru be bakola ensobi mu bigambo bye boogera era nga tebasobola kuziggwayo ddala.
answer_d: Olwokubanga okukola ensobi kitundu ku buli mukutu ogw'okuyiga era abayizi balina okuweebwa omukisa okwogera kyebalowooza nga tebatya.

question: Omusomesa mu somo erikwata ku nzirukanya y'ennimi awa abayizi be omutwe gw'amawulire guno: Ndi mukakafu nti Cristiano Ronaldo agenda kuwummulira mu Madrid. Kika ki kya kigambo ekiri wansi ekirina okukimanyibwa abayizi mu mutwe gw'amawulire oguli waggulu?
answer_a: Ekigerekera ekikola ekintu
answer_b: Ekigambo ekiggumiza erinnya
answer_c: Ekigattiro ekiggumiza embeera
answer_d: Ekigambo ekiggattiddwa ku kigambululo ekiraga obudde, ekifo, oba engeri.

question: Mu kitundu ky’ebitontome, omusomesa asomesa abayizi be ekitontome kino: Mu nnaku ezo nnalina emyaka amakumi abiri era nga ndi mukambwe. Nnali nfiiriddwa ensi naye nga nfuna ekirooto. Era bwe nnalina ekirooto ebyo ebirala byali tebikyali bya mugaso. Ka kibe nga kikwata ku kukola, okusaba, oba okusoma ku makya nga ndi n’embwa ez’omukwano. Ekirooto kyali kibeera mu kifo eky’omwoyo gwange. Ekisenge eky’embaawo, mu kisiikirize, mu bitundu by’obutiti. Era ebiseera ebimu nnafuukafuukanga ne nkyalira ekiro[oto: ekifaananyi eky’olubeerera ekiteekeddwamu ebirowoozo ebirungi, ekisolo ekyeru ekikyukakyuka mu kwagala. Okwagala okutaliiko kkomo. Ekirooto mu kirooto. Era ekirooto ne kigamba nti: ojja kukula. Ojja kuleka emabega ebifaananyi eby’obulumi n’ekizibu era ojja kwerabira. Naye mu nnaku ezo okukula kyandibadde kikyamu. Ndi wano, ne ŋŋamba, n’embwa ez’omukwano era nja kusigala wano. Embwa ez’omukwano, Roberto Bolaño. Kiki ekireetera omuyimbi okuyimba abayizi kye balina okutegeera mu luyimba oluyimbiddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Okwagala kw'omutontomi okw'obutamanya
answer_b: Omutontomi Obutamanya waava(mizizi)
answer_c: Ekirooto ky'obuvubuka bwo'mutontomi
answer_d: Emkiwano gy'omutontomi emivubuka

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa w'ekibiina eky'okubiri asomera abayizi be ekiwandiiko ekiddirira okukola ku kutegeera ebiwandiiko ebiwandiike: "Kyali kifo kisirifu era nga kijjudde enzikiza. Akawoowo k'obunyogovu kaali kajjudde mu bisenge, era ng'ebigere by'omuntu bwe bitambula mu madaala amawanvu, eddoboozi lyabyo lyawulirikanga nnyo." Oluvannyuma lw'okusoma, abayizi abasinga obungi tebaasobola kunnyonnyola kifo ekyo mu bigambo byabwe. Lwaki ekiwandiiko ekyo tekisaanidde kukozesebwa mu kusomesa abayizi b'ekibiina eky'okubiri okutegeera ebiwandiiko?
answer_a: Kubanga kirimu ebigambo ebirina amakulu agategeerekeka
answer_b: Kubanga kirimu obunyiriri obulala.
answer_c: Olwekubanga mulimu ebigambo ebizibu.
answer_d: Kubanga bwe bunnyonnyofu bw’ekifo ekitalina mannya.

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’okuna asaba abayizi okuleeta ebyokulabirako by’enfuumo okuva awaka. Ekklaasi bw’etandika, annyonnyola nti enfumo bububonero obumpi obusobola okukozesa oluyimba era obukiikirira ekitundu ku magezi agaliwo oba amagezi agabantu bonna. Abayizi baleeta enfumo ze baleese, nga muno mulimu: "Embuzi eweereddwa tekebera mannyo", "Mu nnyumba y’omuweesi, akambe k’omuti", era "Akanyonyi akali mu mukono kasinga ebikumi ebiwanuka." Oluvannyuma, mu bibiri bibiri, abayizi bakola kaadi z’enfumo ze baleese okuva awaka, banyumya ku makulu ga buli emu, era oluvannyuma, buli kibiri kinnyonnyola enfumo zaabwe eri ekklaasi. Kintu ki ku kusoma omusomesa ky’asinga okukwatako mu mulimu guno?
answer_a: Okunnyonnyola engeri ennimi ez'ekifaananyi gye zikozesebwa
answer_b: Enkolagana wakati w'ekiwandiiko n'obulamu obwa bulijjo
answer_c: Okwekenneenya amakulu agvamu engero
answer_d: Okutegeera omugaso gwe nnono y'abantu

question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa atandika okusomera abayizi be ab'ekibiina ekisooka olugero buli lunaku, era awandiika ku kibbali ky'ekibiina erinnya ly'olugero lwe bagenda okusoma: "Olugero lw'ekibira eky'ekisiru". Oluvannyuma, abasoomesa okuzuula olugero lwe bagenda okusoma. Josefina ayimusa omukono gwe n'agamba: "Nnyinza okukikola," era n'atandika okusoma mu ddoboozi eriwulikika, ng'addiŋŋana okusoma emirundi ebiri, okutuusa lwe yagamba: "Tugenda kusoma Olugero lw'ekibira eky'ekisiru."Josefina ali mu mutendera gwaki ogw'enkola y'okusoma?
answer_a: Ekyapaango ky'ennukuta
answer_b: Nga tannaba kuwandiika bigambo mu nkula yabyo
answer_c: Olunnukuta
answer_d: Ennyingo z'ebigambo

question: Omusomesa atunuulidde omuwala mu ssomero ly'abaana abato, bw'abadde awandiika erinnya lye, aliwandiise mu ngeri ekyamu, nga bwe kiragiddwa mu kifaananyi kino: Nga tutunuulidde engeri omuwala gy'awandiiseemu, kiti kiki ekyetaaga okukolebwako naye okuyamba okuyiga kwe?
answer_a: Okutegeera okulaba.
answer_b: Okufuga okw'ebbali.
answer_c: Okusoma obuntambula.
answer_d: Okukwataga ya okw'amaaso n'emirimu gy'emikono.

question: Mu kibiina eky’omukaaga, omusomesa w’Olulimi n’Empuliziganya agenda kutandika omutwe guno: "Okuwandiika obutuufu, nga tukozesa amateeka g’akabonero akawunzifu." Kuyiga kyi abayizi kwe balina okumanya okusobola okutegeera akabonero akawunzifu?
answer_a: Omulamwa gw'ekiwummulo
answer_b: Omulamwa gw'akazannyo k'amaloboozi
answer_c: Okutegeera ebigambo eby'akawango kamu
answer_d: Okutegeera ebigambo ebifaanagana mu nnyingo

question: Mu kibiina ky'olulimi, okukozesa omulamwa gw'obubaka obw'ekikungo (propaganda), omusomesa asaba abayizi okukola kampeyini ekubiriza okufaayo ku butonde bw'ensi munda mu ssomero. Ku lw'ekyo, emirimu egy'enjawulo gissibwawo, gamba ng'okutegeera embeera y'essomero ku by'okufaayo ku butonde bw'ensi, okuteekateeka ebiruubirirwa bya kampeyini, okubaga omukutu ogw'obuwangwaazi, n'okunoonya ebikozesebwa eby'obukugu okutambuza omulimu guno. Okukekkereza okutuukirizibwa kw'ekitundu ekisooka ekya kampeyini, omusomesa awa buli kibinja olukalala lw'ebyo bye balina okukola (checklist) basobole okwekebera bokka. Lwaki kisaanira okukozesa olukalala lw'ebyo bye balina okukola mu kitundu kino ekisooka ekya kampeyini?
answer_a: Kubanga buli muyizi asobola okumanya engeri gy’akolamu mu mirimu gye gimuwebwa.
answer_b: Olw’okuba abayizi bajja kusobola okwawula ebikorwa bye bamaze okukola mu biti.
answer_c: Kubanga abayizi bajja kusobola okwekenneenya mu bujjuvu buli kimu ku bikolwa bye bakoze.
answer_d: Kubanga abayizi bajja kusobola okukakasa oba bamalirizza emirimu egibadde gibakwasiddwa egyekuusa ku kampeyini.

question: Abayizi abali mu kibiina ekyomusanvu bakola ku nkola entongole eye muko gw'empapula z'amawulire, era olw'ensonga eno, omusomesa abasabye okufulumya ebiwandiiko by'amawulire. Kiki ku bintu ebikozesebwa  wammanga ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukakasa obanga ebintu ebikola empapula z'amawulire birabika mu biwandiiko ebyafulumiziddwa?
answer_a: entunda y'okusiima
answer_b: Olukalala lw'eby'okukakasa
answer_c: Ebikuumibwa bya anecdotali.
answer_d: Ekyokulabirako ekikulembera

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ekisoma okunnyonnyola ebiwandiiko ebirimu okukaayana mu mwaka ogwokusatu ogw’ekisulo, ng’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga kiri ‘Kutegeera endowooza y’omuwandiisi, ensonga ze n’engeri gy’akozesaamu obukodyo bw’okuwandiika obulungi’, omusomesa ateekwa abayizi okusoma n’okugeraageranya ebbaluwa eri omukulu w’amawulire ezikwata ku nsonga y’emu. Ku biragiro by’okukebera ebiteereddwa wammanga, kiruwa ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga ekyateereddwawo mu kibiina?
answer_a: Londa omulamwa omukulu ogw'ebiwandiiko eby'enjawulo, ng'otunuulira enkozesa y'ebigambo n'engeri ebigambo bwe bitegekeddwa.
answer_b: Gerageranya engeri emiramwa gy’emyawulo egyolekeddwamu mu biwandiiko eby’enjawulo okusinziira ku ngeri ebirowoozo gye bitegekeddwamu n’engeri ebigambo gye bikozesebwamu.
answer_c: Kola endowooza yo ku nsonga eyanjuddwa mu biwandiiko eby'enjawulo, ng'okozesa ebikozesebwa eby'obumu n'obwegattiro.
answer_d: Wawula amakulu ag'omutwe, ng'osinziira ku by'obuwangwa ebikozeseddwa, okutegeera ekigendererwa ky'omuwandiiko.

question:
Omusomesa akola n'abayizi be ab'ekibiina ekyokusatu ku kutegeera ebyo basoma okusinziira ku lugero "Empungu Eyekka." Wammanga waliwo ekitundu ekiggyiddwa mu mwoleso guno:
Edda nnyo, kyategekebwa nti ebinyonyi byonna eby'oku lusozi oluli okumpi n'ennyanja birina okufumbiriganwa. Okutuukiriza ekyo, ebirango byateekebwawo buli we waali osobola okusobozesa ebinyonyi okukung'aana ku mukolo. Waali wasigaddeewo obutikitiki butono okutandika omukolo era ebinyonyi byonna byali birindirira nnyo akadde ako, naye empungu yali terina gw'efumbirwa. Nga anakuwadde, yagenda. Embaga zaakolebwa; ebinyonyi byajaganya, newankubadde tebyeerabira nnaku y'empungu.
Omu ku bayizi be abuuza omusomesa: "Okunakuwala" kitegeeza ki?
Kino ku bino wammanga kiki ekiyinza okuyamba omuyizi okutegeera amakulu g'ekigambo kino ng'ayita mu kumanya akatundu akasooka ak'ekigambo?
answer_a: Noonya ekigambo ekiri mu kika kye kimu eky'ekigambo mu biwandiiko n'okugatta ebigambo byombi no obukodyo mu biwandiiko ebiyamba okuzuula amakulu gaakyo.
answer_b: Noonya ebigambo ebirala mu kiwandiiko ebirimu ebigambo ebigattibwako,obisazeeko era obikwataganye okusalawo ebigambo byonna ky'ebifaanaganya.
answer_c: Noonya ebigambo ebiraga obubonero bwa 'condor' mu kiwandiiko, obisazeeko era n'okubikwataganya n'ekigambo ky'oyagala okuzuula ky'ekitegeeza.
answer_d: Noonya ekikolwa eky'eyongerayo  n'ekigambo ky'oyagala okuzuula ky'ekitegeeza era obikwataganye n'ebigambo bibiri n'ensonga eriranaganye n'ekiwandiiko.

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. Mukusooka, bali bakusoma kinnomu atte mukasirise, oluvanyumma, baatule, nga bagoberera obubonero obwempandika. Kika ki eky'okuyiga ekifuna mu mu bikolwa ebilagiddwa?
answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Ku  bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n’omuwala oba omulenzi ali ku mutendera gwa “syllabic-alphabetic” mu kuwandiika?
answer_a: Okukoppa erinnya lyabwe
answer_b: Awandiika  ebigambo ebyefananyiriza.
answer_c: awandiika ennyukuta ezaawukanye ze bamanyi.
answer_d: Akoppolola ebigambo ebitono okusobola okubaako kyayogerezeganya.

question: Ekitongole ekikuumira ebikozesebwa mu kusomesa mu ssomero kirina ebintu eby’enjawulo eby’okusomesa ebigendereddwa okukulaakulanya olulimi. Omusomesa w’abaana abato alina okulonda ekintu ky’ayagala okukozesa okusomesa abayizi be ku kumanya amateeka agafuga olulimi. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo waggulu, kiki ekisinga okuba ekyetaagisa okukozesebwa butereevu okukulaakulanya okumanya amateeka agafuga olulimi?
answer_a: Empapula eziriko ebigambo ebitegeeza ebitali bimu
answer_b: Domino y'eddoboozi ly'ennukuta entandisi
answer_c: Kaadi z’okulambika ebifaananyi n’ebigambo
answer_d: Kaadi z’okuzimbisa sentensi nga tukozesa obubonero bw’ebifaananyi.

question:
Soma mu kakko akava mu kiwandiiko ekya weebwayo omwana ali mu siniya ey'okubiri:

Mu katabo, omuntu asobola okulaba ewatali ddembe mu bawandikibwako , naddala omuntu akatabo gwe'ketolelako, okukola kyebaagala oba okweyisa nga bwe baagala. Ng'ekyokulabirako, mu kifo ekimu omuntu eyawandika ku katabo agamba nti tewali n'omu asobola kuwasa gw'ayagala ebyaddala kubanga bwe bakwatibwa basobola okusibwa oba okuttibwa. Kino kilabika bubi nnyo kubanga omuntu tasobola kuba ne ddembe okubeera n'omuntu gw'ayagala era, oluusi, mu nnaku zino, kino kisobola okulabika, ng'ekyokulabirako, abantu bw'akakibwa oba okwekaka okubeera n'omuntu olw'obwangu obw'efanana oba ssente so si lwa kwagala.
Ku bino ebiteekateeke ebisobola okuva eri omusomesa ku kiwandiiko ky'omuyizi, kiki ku bino ekiyinza okuba eky'amugaso ku nkozesa y'ebikwata ku biwandiiko?
answer_a: Bw’otooteekemu biwandiiko eby’okukakasa, endowooza zo zijja kuggwaamu obutuufu.
answer_b: Yongera ku kamunnyeenye ako n’ensonga endala ey’ekizibu era ogiwagire n’ekigambo ekiggiddwa mu katabo.
answer_c: Singa mu kifo ky’okwogera ku katabo, onoonnyonnyola ekitundu ky’ekiwandiiko ky’oyagala okwogerako, kyandibadde kyeyolefu.
answer_d: Ddamu osome omulongoosa ogunnyonnyola ebyo ebinukuta ebyoleka bye bikola era otunule nnyo ku byokulabirako ebiragiddwa.

question: Omusomesa wa kkindagateni yeetaaga okukola okukebera okuzuula obukugu bw'abaana mu bigambo, naddala obusobozi bwabwe okumanya amakulu g'ebigambo n'okutegeera ekibinja kye bigwaamu. Mbeera ki ey'omusomo esaanira okukungaanya obukakafu obukwata ku bukugu buno?
answer_a: Yita abaana okuzannya emizannyo gy'okuteebereza. Ebintu ebikulu ebikwata ku bigambo eby'enjawulo bijja kwogerwako, nga tokozesezza buyambi bwa kubiraba. Kozesa olukalala lw'ebintu okuwandiika engeri abaana gye bakolamu.
answer_b: Laga abaana ebintu eby’enjawulo n’ebisero ebikiikirira ebibinja eby’enjawulo, obasabe okulonda ekimu ku bintu ebyo, okwogera erinnya lyakyo, n’okukissa mu kibinja mwe kigwa.Pima enkola ng'okozesa ekipimo.
answer_c: Yiita abaana okwetegereza akataabaliro akalimu ebibinja eby’enjawulo, era obawa kaadi ze balina okukwataganya n’ekibinja ekikwatagana nazo. Kozesa ebiwandiiko by'okwekaliriza okuwandiika enkola.
answer_d: Laga abaana empapula erimu ebika by'ebifaananyi by’ebintu eby’enjawulo, obasabe okulonda ekimu bakinyonnyole nga tebogedde linnya lyakyo. Bannaabwe balina okwogera ekigambo ekyo n’okwogera ekika kyakyo. Kebera engeri gye bakozesezzaamu ebipimo.

question: Omusomesa w'abaana ab'omutendera ogw'omu makkati yetegeereza nti ekibinja kye ekya abaana aboobuwala na aboobulenzi banyumirwa ebibaawo mu kuyiiya n'okunooyereza nga bakozesa emikono gyabwe mirundi mingi bwe bikozesebwa sitoole okuva mu mabaluwa ,magazini,obubonero. N'olwekyo,kutandikwa y'olusoma olw'okubiri, era abasaba entobo y'olulimi lw'ebigambo,"Okufulumya ebintu ebifaananyi ebiraga ebifaananyi byabwe mu mbeera z'okuzannya."-Okutuukiriza okukolagana kwa by'okulaba ne by'okunyakanya okuyita mu nkozesa y'ebintu eby'enjawulo,eby'okuzannyisa n'ebikozesebwa."Bumalirivu ki obw'okuyiga obutuukiriza ekiruubirwa ekyogeddwa omusomesa?
answer_a: Mu kibinja ekinene, mukole omulimu gw'okusoma ebitontome; oluvannyuma, abaana bakoppe ebigambo ebimu nga bwe beetondeera obubaka bwabwe.
answer_b: Mu bubinja obutono, abaana basabiddwa okusalako ebigambo okuva mu magazini n'empapula z'amawulire, ate oluvannyuma okukoppa ebimu ku byo nga bakola ebiwandiiko ebipya.
answer_c: Mu bubinja obutono, abaana bakubirizibwa okuwandiika awamu ekifo ky’emmere, oluvannyuma bafumbe nga bakozesa ebijiko, enfuuwe, n’ebbakuli okukola omugatte.
answer_d: Mu kibinja ekinene, somesa olugero mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka ate oluvannyuma oyite abaana okusiiga ebifaananyi by'ekibaawo eky'omugongo oba ebifo eby'enjawulo okuva mu lugero nga banoonyereza amannya g'abazannyi.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’okusatu agenda kukola omulimu gw’okuwandiika olugero n’abayizi be, ng’asinga kwesigama ku ngeri y’okukyusaamu okutambulira awamu n’embeera y’okwogera. Nga twejjukanya ku ky’omusingi guno eky’omulimu guno, mu bibuuzo bino omusomesa by’abuuza, kibuuzo ki ekisaanidde okusinga abayizi okutandika okuteekateeka engeri gye bagenda okuwandiikaamu ebyo bye baagala okuwandiika?
answer_a: Olugero lwaffe luliyogera ku ki?
answer_b: Tugenda kuwandiikira ani olugero lwaffe?
answer_c: Olugero lwaffe lugenda kusiimattuka wa?
answer_d: Lulimi ki lwe tugenda okukozesa mu lugero lwaffe?

question: Mu kibiina kya siniya esooka, mu kiseera ky'okusoma ku nfumo n'ebitontome ebikwata ku butonde, omusomesa alina ekiruubirirwa kino: "Okwekenneenya ekifo ky'abantu ab'enjawulo mu nfumo ezikwata ku butonde." Okusobola okutuuka ku kino, alonze enfumo ez'enjawulo ezikoleddwa obuwangwa obw'enjawulo.Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira abayizi okukola okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Kola kaadi eziraga abantu abali mu nfumo n'obuwangwa bwe bavaamu.
answer_b: Kola ebifaananyi ebiraga enjawulo wakati w'abantu abakulu, abato n'abatali ba mugaso mu nfumo ezirondebwa
answer_c: Kola emmeeza eziraga engeri ebintu ebimu ebiri mu nfumo ezo gye bikwataganamu n’ebintu ebya bulijjo ebibinnyonnyolwako.
answer_d: Wandiika obuwandiike obumpimpi mwe bannyonnyola empisa z'abantu abakulu abali mu nfumo gye beeyisaamu.

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. Mukusooka, bali bakusoma kinnomu atte mukasirise, oluvanyumma, baatule, nga bagoberera obubonero obwempandika. Kika ki eky'okuyiga ekifuna mu mu bikolwa ebilagiddwa?
answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Omusomesa,  mu siniya ey'okubiri, agenda kukola okunoonyereza n’abayizi ku byafaayo by’ebitabo eby’Omulembe Ogwa Zaabu, ng’asingira ku mpisa n’embeera y’ebyafaayo ey’ekiseera ekyo. Oluvannyuma lw’okunoonyereza ku yintaneeti, abayizi bagenda kuteeka awamu olukalala lw’ebitabo olugazi, ate oluvannyuma balonde ebiwandiiko ebisinga okuba ebituufu okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky’okunoonyereza. Ki ku bino  wammanga omusomesa by’ateesseza,  ogusinga okuba omutuufu okulonda ebiwandiiko ebinoonyerezeddwako?
answer_a: Kola ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku by'osomye okusinziira ku nsibuko z'osomyeko oluvannyuma osalewo ensibuko ki gy'ogenda okukozesa.
answer_b: Sooka osome ebiwandiiko mu bujjuvu okusobola okutegeera ensonga enkulu, oluvannyuma wetegeleze obukulu bw'amawulire ago okusinziira ku bigendererwa by'okunoonyereza.
answer_c: Kozesa obukodyo okuzuula omutwe n'ensonga enkulu ey'ensibuko z'osomyeko oluvannyuma ogatte obubaka okusinziira ku mitwe emitono, okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky'okunoonyereza
answer_d: Kola ebiwandiiko ebikulu ebikwata ku nsibuko era oteekewo ebiwandiiko ebiraga obubaka obutwalibwa okuba nga bwe businga okuba obw’omugaso mu kunoonyereza.

question: Omusomesa wa siniya, mu mutendera ogwookuna mu kitundu kye nyinnyonyola y'omulembe guno,alaga okunnyonyola okw'enjawulo naddala ku biwandiiko eby'omulembe guno. Oluvannyuma lw'okunyonyola endowooza ya polyphony mu biwandiiko wamu n'eby'okulabirako ebimu, akizuula nti waliwo abayizi abatannaba kutegeera bulungi kibeeramu biki. Mu kubanguyiza okutegeera, asalawo okunyonyola endowooza okuyita mu kugeerageranya. Kugeerageranya ki omusomesa kwa nakozesa okulaga okubanguyiza okutegeera mu ndowooza ya polyphony mu biwandiiko?
answer_a: Ekibiina ky'abayimbi ekya ssomero kiyimba oluyimba lw'essomero ku mukolo gw'eggwanga.
answer_b: Omukwano ogumu gusisinkana oluvannyuma lw'oluwummula okugabana ebifaananyi byabwe n'ebyo bye bayitamu.
answer_c: Omuntu ali mu kisaawe era n'ayogera ku nneeyisa y'abaana abakilizaawo.
answer_d: Omufumbo gw’ebimuli bwe gugwa okuva ku bbalakoni ne gugwa ku mmotoka eyimiridde, abalabye boogera bye baalabye.

question: Mu kibiina  eky'omunaana, omusomesa asaba abayizi okusoma olugero olumpi oluyitibwa 'Olugero' olwa Wislawa Szymborska ate oluvannyuma bakole ebibuuzo ebiyamba okutegeera obulungi ebyo ebiri mu lugero. Abavubi  abamu baaggya eccupa okuva wansi mu nnyanja. Munda mu ccupa mwalimu olupapula, era ku lupapula kwaliko ebigambo bino: "Muyambe!, Ndi eno. Ennyanja ensumuludde ku kizinga okutali bantu. Ndi ku lubalama era ninda buyambi. Mwanguyeko! Ndi wano!" –Tekuli lunaku. era kilabaika okuba  nga wayiseewo ebbanga ddene. Eccupa yandiba nga emaze ebbanga ddene nga etengejja – omuvubi eyasooka bwe yagamba. –Era ekifo tekiragiddwa. Tekimanyiddwa wadde nnyanja ki – omuvubi owookubiri bwe yagamba. –Si kya lubeerera wadde kya wala. Ekizinga 'Wano' kiri buli wantu – omulenzi omuvubi owookusatu bwe yagambye. Embeera yafuuka mbi, obusirise ne bubaawo. Amazima agawamu galina ekizibu ekyo. Mu bibuuzo bino wamanga ebyakolebwa abayizi, kibuuzo ki ekikulembera okutegeera amakulu g'olugero olusomeddwa?
answer_a: Ekigambo 'ekizinga "Wano" kiri buli wantu' kitegeeza ki?
answer_b: Enkomerero y’olugero yandibadde etya singa obubaka bwali busengeke bulungi?
answer_c: Lwaki abavubi tebawulira bulungi n’okuddamu kw’omusajja owookusatu?
answer_d: Singa osanga  eccupa erimu obubaka ng’obwo, wandikoze ki era lwaki?

question: Mu kibiina eky'okutaano,omusomesa ajja okwekkeneenya kyenkana ki abayizi be kye basomye ku nsengeka y'ebikolwa eby'okuzannya katemba Era okutuukiriza kino, agenda kuwandiika  ebiraga eby'enjawulo ebyo kulungamya okunoonya obujulizi ku by'ayize ebifunibwa .Kwekkeneenya ki wammanga okulaga akwawunti ezookutegera olutalo muzannyo gwo okuzannya katemba.
answer_a: Wawulaana ebikolwa ebikolebwa abantu abakola omuzannyo.
answer_c: Laga ensonga eziviiriddeko omuzannyi omukulu n’omuzannyi omubi okukola bye bakola mu muzannyo.
answer_d: Laga engeri ebikolwa by'omuntu omukulu n'omulabe mu muzannyo gye bikwatagana n'ebyo bye bayitamu.

question: Omusomesa mu mwaka gwe ogwookusatu mu ssomero lya siniya,akola wamu n'abayizi be kubiruubirirwa bino wammanga:"okutegeera sitayiro y'okunnyumya." Nga mu kino, annyonyola obubonero bwa buli sitayiro,era alaga eby'okulabirako ebimu era awabula abayizi okwetegereza sitayiro mu bitundu eby'enjawulo ebiggiddwamu. Ekimu ku bitundu  mu sitayiro etali nteerevu wammanga: "Charles yeewunya obweru obuli mu njala ze. Zaali ntaagavuwamu n'obugumu ku nkomerero yaazo nga zakula bulungi n'amasanga ga diyeppi eyakula nga amanda. Naye omukono tegwali mulungi mpozzi n'okusiibuuka,era nga gufanaana nga embalaasi mu nnyingo; era gwali muwanvu nnyo era nga gubulamu ebifuga ebigonvu eza miyala z'enkula. Ekyali ekirungi ge maaso; newankubadde gaali ga kitaka, galabika nga amaddugavu olw'obukoowekoowe nga era entunula yali  n'obwesimbu n'obuvumu bwe bbugumu."(Madam Bovary, Gustave Flaubert). Omu ku bayizi addamu nti ekitundu kirina sitayiro etali ntereevu kubanga waliwo omunyumya w'omuntu owookusatu. Nga otunuulira okuddamu okwo,kesiima ki okukwatagana ne sitayiro z'okunyumya eyetaagisa omusomesa okukozesa eri abayizi okutugeera sitayiro etali ntereevu?
answer_a: Okutegeera engeri omutontomi gy’atunuuliramu ebiri mu lugero
answer_b: Okutegeera ebika by’abanoonyereza mu mboozi
answer_c: Enjawulo wakati w'eddoboozi ly'omunnyonnyozi n'ery'abantu abakola ebikolwa mu lugero
answer_d: Okumanya omuntu annyonnyola byafaayo gy’ayimiridde okutunulira ebyo by’annyonnyola.

question: Bukenkufu ki ku bukuweredwa  ,obusobola okumanyisa  amakulu g'ebigambo  era lwaki?
answer_a: Okutondekawo sentensi n'olukalala lw'ebiseera kubanga bikiriza okutegeka ebigambo.
answer_b: Okukola okwawula n'okufaananya okw'omumwa kubanga bikusobozesa okuwa amakulu eri ebigambo
answer_c: Okwegezaamu mu ntambula oba envugga n’okwawula ebigambo mu nsalango kubanga bikusobozesa okutegeera eddoboozi ly’ebigambo.
answer_d: Okukozesa emizannyo gy'ebiseera by'ebikolwa n'okunnyonnyola empisa z'abantu kubanga bikusobozesa okutegeka ebigambo.

question: Ku biragiro bino wammanga, kiki ekireetera omuyizi okukulaakulanya okumanya enkozesa y'olulimi mu mbeera ez’enjawulo?
answer_a: Zuula ensobi mu kyogera mu bigambo ebiri mu ngero ennyimpi.
answer_b: Kola engero ez'ebigambo ng'okozesa kaadi ez'ebifaananyi by'ebigambo.
answer_c: Gongyola ebiwandiiko  ebikuweeredwa mu bikikyo ebyenjawulo
answer_d: Tegeka sentensi ennyangu mu ngeri endala ku eyo eteereddwaawo.
